The explicit depends_on on azurerm_template_deployment.ase is redundant: the external data source's program already references azurerm_template_deployment.ase.outputs, so Terraform already orders it after the ASE deployment.

The explicit depends_on on azuread_service_principal.app is redundant because the local-exec provisioner already references azuread_service_principal.app.id in its environment, creating the same ordering implicitly.
The explicit depends_on on azurerm_recovery_services_vault.asr_rg_vault is redundant because recovery_vault_name already references azurerm_recovery_services_vault.asr_rg_vault.name.

The AKS cluster should be created only after the AKS MSI preview feature registration null_resource has run, but there is no dependency from the cluster to that null_resource. The local-exec registration must complete before AKS is provisioned.

keyvault_access_policies creates azurerm_key_vault_access_policy resources against the key vault, so it must depend on the key vaults module. The keyvault_id argument currently comes through a local and the graph shows no ordering edge to module.keyvaults.

The App Service Environment is deployed into a subnet supplied from the combined networking object, so it must be ordered after module.networking. The graph currently shows no dependency from the ASE module to networking.

Private DNS virtual network links use the combined networking object, so private DNS zone vnet links require module.networking. The graph shows no dependency from module.private_dns to module.networking.
